Rocky Meadows Country Getaway When you’re at Rocky Meadows Country Getaway, fun is never far away! The campground has 56 full-service sites (power, water, sewer), including 20 pull-through sites, a group site with power for up to 15 units, onsite RV rentals, and tent sites. You’ll also find all the amenities to make your stay comfortable including firepits, showers, flush toilets, and laundry. Rocky Meadows also offers a home away from home with monthly and seasonal rates. Once you’re all set up, there are a variety of activities to enjoy. Check out the spring fed pond, enjoy catch and release trout
